description: Presidential Secretariat - Enlarge the Time ending 30th May, 2021 by Five months from 30.05.2021 to 31.10.221 for rendition of the final report on Completion of the tasks assigned to the Commission of Inquiry
reasoning: This gazette content involves the President exercising powers under the Commission of Inquiry Act to extend the deadline for a commission's final report.
